stepExplanation: The mRNA sequence is the same as the DNA coding strand, except that thymine (T) is replaced with uracil (U). The coding strand has the same sequence as the mRNA (with T replaced by U), while the template strand is complementary to both.
stepBody: Write the mRNA sequence that would be produced from this DNA coding strand. Remember: The coding strand has the same sequence as the mRNA (except T becomes U in RNA).
